messages:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: root cause looks like combined pressure on cloud metadata + an undocumented vendor auth rate-limit. Resulted in transient deploy failures and inference 502s. Need concrete owners and timelines for mitigations.

alex: I'll take client-side hardening: implement exponential backoff with full jitter, add a short circuit to avoid token storms. Will open PR and canary plan today; target deploy Fri COB.

jihoon: I'll prototype a read-only manifest mirror and serve cached manifests when registry is down. Also propose bumping model manifest TTL to 5m with jitter to avoid thundering herd. Prototype by next Tue.

tara: I'll add edge protections: 429 handling and a feature-flagged throttle at the gateway so we can limit outbound burst to vendor endpoints. 24h ETA.

sre-lead: Add an alert rule: token refresh error rate >= 5% over 5m should page oncall. Also create a dashboard panel for vendor-dependent error spikes. I'll do that within 48h.

incident-bot: Runbook updated https://internal.redwood/runbooks/vendor-outage-2712467890 (owners: alex, jihoon, tara)

maya: Action checklist (update with PR/issue links):
- alex: backoff + circuit + runbook command (Fri COB)
- tara: 429 handler + gateway throttle flag (24h)
- jihoon: registry mirror prototype + TTL change doc (Tue)
- sre-lead: alert + dashboard (48h)

alex: I'll also draft vendor escalation steps and add a contact matrix to the runbook. We should formalize SLOs and include them in vendor contracts.

jihoon: Adding degradation policy doc and steps to pin fallback model versions. I'll include a quick CLI snippet to flip to mirror.

tara: I'll schedule a 10-min drill with oncall to exercise the flip tomorrow after landing the throttle change.

maya: Good. Reconvene during next week's post-incident review with PRs and drill notes. If anyone is blocked ping me. :thumbsup:
